I1 — explanations behind a section ⓘ, data notes clamped and folded #1351, with #1350, #1336, #1342 · 390 px

The pick is made: variant R of the I1 prototype (ux-design-2026-11-01-i1/proposal.js), adopted by the owner on 2026-11-01. No other variant is drawn. This board draws R on the shipped markup of three pages, before and after, with the classification the build uses per text.

Two corrections, found while drawing, are the default unless a comment flips them: a note that names rows left out of a total never folds, it only clamps; and a note's remedy control stays visible under the clamp. Synthetic data only (review seed).

  • 1Section ⓘ. The section's method sentences — how a figure is computed, what a term means — leave the page and sit in one ⓘ beside the heading, one source line per line (the existing details.metric-tooltip, label „Zu diesem Abschnitt“). A facet that already has an ⓘ on its basis line takes them there.
  • 2The basis line stays. View, period, currency, as-of, gross/net, the set of rows and a threshold stay visible (UX-DR11: every number states its basis). Only the method clauses of a line move; a line that already ends in its own ⓘ stays whole.
  • 3A clamped data note. Two lines, three under 560 px; „mehr“ only where the text is cut. A remedy control (button, disclosure) stays visible under the text. A note that names rows left out of a total keeps its count in its first line; the names are one tap away (UX-DR25 as the owner amended it on 2026-11-01).
  • 4Folded notes. Two or more attention/note items in one block that do not name excluded rows fold into one line with their counts, at the highest folded severity: „1 Achtung · 1 Hinweis — Details anzeigen“.
  • 5Problems stay visible. A problem never folds and leads its block; it clamps like every note.
  • 6#1350. The view switcher's ⓘ is a metric-tooltip: its panel floats below the switcher instead of opening as a paragraph that pushes the KPI cards down.
  • 7#1336. An ⓘ panel opens upward unless there is no room above, then below; it is shifted so both edges stay 1 rem inside the viewport. A small hook measures on toggle (data-place, --tip-shift).
  • 8#1342, no picture. Escape closes an open ⓘ and returns focus to its summary — every ⓘ on this board, the section ⓘ and the view switcher's included. The Imports picker's (H45) hit count and „Kein Wertpapier passt.“ move into a role="status" region; that page is not drawn here.

Vermögen /portfolio, above the positions table

Before: the view switcher's ⓘ is open and lays its text out as a paragraph under the switcher (#1350); eight notes stack in Datenqualität; the contribution's method sentences sit under its table. After: the ⓘ floats (⑥); the three problems lead (⑤), the three notes that name rows left out of the totals clamp (③), the two others fold (④); the contribution's formula and its two rules move into the ⓘ beside „Beitrag je Position“ (①) while „je Position in EUR, einschließlich der Währungsbewegung“ stays (②). The second row of KPI cards, the chart, all but three contribution rows and the rows that belong to no position are cut in both frames.

Übersicht /

After: the value card's note keeps „Nicht in der Summe: 3 Verrechnungskonten …“ in its first line and clamps the names (③); the KPI strip's basis line already ends in its own ⓘ and stays whole (②). „Abgeschlossene Trades“ keeps its basis „Die 5 zuletzt abgeschlossenen · Ergebnis in EUR · FIFO über alle Depots, unabhängig von der Ansicht“ (②) and its p. a. rule moves into the ⓘ, drawn open (①). „Fällig“ keeps its first sentence, the set and the window, and its second moves (①). The data-quality line is a problem and stays (⑤). Lists are cut in both frames; Ziel-Abweichungen does not change.

Cashflow → Trades /cashflow?tab=realized, the facet ⓘ opened

Before: the facet's ⓘ panel opens upward from a line near the top of the page, so it starts 116 px above the screen and runs to x = 586 on a 390 px screen (#1336); the hatched band is what cannot be read. After: with no room above it opens below, shifted -241 px to stay inside the screen (⑦), and it now also holds the method clauses of the trades' basis line, „Einlieferungen eröffnen keinen Lot“ and the p. a. rule (①). The two exclusion notes clamp and keep their buttons (③); the gross/net clauses stay under the table (②). The three figures, all but one trade and the sections below are cut in both frames.

How the build classifies a text

Per text, not per CSS class: .hint, .muted and .summary-basis carry all four classes today. The tests run top to bottom; the first that holds decides. Anything inside a table, a row, a form's field help or a dialog is out of scope and does not move.

Found while drawing

  • Excluded rows never fold (default; a comment „fold them too“ flips it to the prototype). R folded every attention note; on Cash flow → Trades that hid both exclusion notes behind „2 Achtung“, and on Wealth three of the four. The owner's decision keeps the count of excluded rows visible, so a note that names rows left out of a total only clamps. Wealth's fold therefore reads „1 Achtung · 1 Hinweis“, not the prototype's „4 Achtung · 1 Hinweis“.
  • Remedy controls stay visible under the clamp (default). R clamped the whole note body, which hid „Wechselkurse synchronisieren“ and „Historische Wechselkurse nachladen“ behind „mehr“; the note's text clamps, its button or disclosure does not (UX-DR17 clause 3, the remedy is a child of the note).
  • The prototype decided by clause length (42 characters); the build decides per text by the table below. Two lines the length rule would have hidden stay: Fällig's first sentence (the set and the window) and the threshold of Ziel-Abweichungen.
  • The section ⓘ panel is wider (26 rem, still 1 rem inside a phone screen) because it holds several lines; a term's ⓘ keeps 18 rem.
